title: Pricing Basis for Gallons Released Out of a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Booking
content:
The price gallons released out of a booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts are settled at turns on how large the undrawn position is and on whether a will-call stop has been billed recently.

**What a will-call stop is.** A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking.

**Where the gallons standing undrawn reach 2 times the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and 1 or more will-call stops were billed on the account in the three months ending on the handling date**, the settlement price is the mean of the contracted price of record and the posted price of the day, carried to four decimal places.

**Where those gallons reach 2 times the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and no will-call stop was billed in that window**, the settlement price is the contracted price of record standing on the account.

**Where those gallons fall under 2 times the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the settlement price is the contracted price of record standing on the account or the posted price of the day, whichever is the lower.

**The posted price of the day** for this purpose is the price billed on the most recent will-call stop, carried to four decimal places.

| Gallons standing undrawn | Will-call stops billed in the three months ending on the handling date | The settlement price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At or above 2 times the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | 1 or more | The mean of the contracted price of record and the posted price of the day, to four decimal places |
| At or above 2 times the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | None | The contracted price of record |
| Below 2 times the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Either way | The lower of the contracted price of record and the posted price of the day |

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose minimum pre-buy gallons stand at 1000, an account with 2400.0 gallons standing undrawn, a contracted price of record of 1.8000 USD per gallon and a most recent will-call stop billed at 2.0000 USD per gallon settles at 1.9000 USD per gallon. Had no will-call stop been billed in the quarter, it would settle at 1.8000. Had only 1900.0 gallons stood undrawn, it would settle at the lower of the two, being 1.8000.
